Most health insurance claims in India get rejected, so why pay for a policy

According to the IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25, about 87% of health claims were paid and only 8% were rejected. As reported by IndiaMedToday, in 2023–24 insurers paid roughly 83% of claims and rejected about 11%. Does that change how you see it?
